name: test-data-generator
description: Make realistic fake data for demos, tests and training — Chinese or English names, mobile numbers, emails, cities and addresses, companies, dates, amounts, member levels with the mix you want, IDs, UUIDs and codes like ORD-1234-AB. Describe the columns in a small table (or load a schema sheet), choose how many rows, and export CSV, Excel, JSON or SQL. Everything is invented, and the same seed always gives the same data. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 为演示、测试和培训生成逼真的假数据——中英文姓名、手机号、邮箱、城市和地址、公司名、日期、金额、按你想要的比例分布的会员等级、编号、UUID 和 ORD-1234-AB 这样的代码。在小表格里描述各列（或载入字段定义表），选好行数，导出 CSV、Excel、JSON 或 SQL。所有数据都是编造的，相同的随机种子永远生成相同的数据。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
